values.meaning: innate bonus attack speed by champion level
values.binNote: Bin row stores the value as a fraction (0.15 to 0.35); wiki states it as a percentage (15 to 35), same number scaled by 100.

values.meaning: tripled bonus attack speed for 5s after casting an ability
values.quote: this bonus is tripled to {{pplevel|15*3 to 35*3|key=%|color=as}} for 5 seconds
values.binNote: Bin's EmpoweredAS is BonusAS*3 as a fraction (0.45 to 1.05); wiki states it as a percentage (45 to 105), same number scaled by 100.

values.meaning: duration of the tripled attack speed buff
duration a Moonsilver Blade stack lasts before falling off
values.quote: generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Moonsilver Blade'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks

values.meaning: maximum number of Moonsilver Blade stacks
values.binNote: No bin field carries the stack cap of 2; AttackCount (3) instead corresponds to the total attack that triggers the empowered cleave, not the stack cap.

values.meaning: the Nth basic attack (in quick succession) that becomes empowered
values.quote: Every third basic attack in quick succession will cleave nearby enemies

values.meaning: magic damage dealt by the empowered cleave attack
values.quote: {{pplevel|20+5*(x-1) for 6; then + 10*x for 5; then + 15*x for 5; then + 25*x}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks on-hit generate a stack of Moonsilver Blade, refreshing its duration on subsequent attacks, up to 2 stacks.
mechanics.quote: basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Moonsilver Blade'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times

mechanics.claim: At 2 stacks, the next basic attack is empowered and consumes the stacks on-hit to additionally cleave nearby enemies for bonus magic damage.
mechanics.quote: At 2 stacks, '''Diana''' empowers her next basic attack to consume the stacks {{tip|on-hit}} to additionally cleave nearby enemies, dealing them ... magic damage

mechanics.claim: When stacks are consumed by another on-hit effect (e.g. Guinsoo's Rageblade), the additional damage is only applied to the on-hit target without triggering the cleave on nearby enemies.
mechanics.quote: When the stacks are consumed {{tip|on-hit}} (e.g {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}}, {{ii|Dusk and Dawn}}), additional damage is only applied to the on-hit target, without triggering the cleave on nearby enemies.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack sometimes fails to consume the stacks, in which case it also fails to deal its damage (bug).
mechanics.quote: Sometimes, the empowered basic attack will not consume the stacks. ... In this case, the attack will also not deal its damage.

mechanics.claim: Moonsilver Blade deals 270% damage against monsters.
